stories.title: Reform receives second £36m donation in two days as crypto investor matches record

en.title: Reform receives second £36m donation in two days as crypto investor matches record
en.summary: Reform UK has received a second £36 million donation within two days from crypto investor Christopher Harborne, matching a previous donation and equalling the largest single gift ever given to a UK political party.

stories.title: Norris takes Madrid pole with 'gorgeous' lap

en.title: Norris takes Madrid pole with 'gorgeous' lap
en.summary: Lando Norris secured pole position for McLaren at the Spanish Grand Prix, finishing ahead of Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli and Red Bull's Max Verstappen.

stories.title: Man arrested after police van targeted at anti-migrant protest in Portsmouth

en.title: Man arrested after police van targeted at anti-migrant protest in Portsmouth
en.summary: A man was arrested following an incident involving a police van at an anti-migrant protest in Portsmouth. Social media footage showed a protester attempting to circumvent mask regulations.

stories.title: F1 Spanish GP LIVE: Race start time and schedule with Norris on ‘shock pole

en.title: F1 Spanish GP LIVE: Race start time and schedule with Norris on 'shock pole
en.summary: Lando Norris achieved an unexpected pole position at the Spanish Grand Prix qualifying session, narrowly edging out Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli for first place.

stories.title: Lando Norris stuns rivals to claim remarkable pole for first F1 race in Madrid

en.title: Lando Norris stuns rivals to claim remarkable pole for first F1 race in Madrid
en.summary: Lando Norris achieved pole position at the inaugural Formula 1 Madrid race, describing the qualifying lap as one of his best. He finished ahead of Kimi Antonelli and Max Verstappen.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia shuts down key oil pipeline, blaming drones from Iraq

en.title: Saudi Arabia shuts down key oil pipeline, blaming drones from Iraq
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has closed a major oil pipeline after accusing Iraqi militants of drone attacks. The kingdom has relied on this 1,200km route to bypass the Strait of Hormuz blockade since the US-Israeli war against Iran began.

stories.title: Lando Norris shocks himself by pipping Kimi Antonelli to F1 Spanish GP pole

en.title: Lando Norris shocks himself by pipping Kimi Antonelli to F1 Spanish GP pole
en.summary: Lando Norris secured pole position at the Formula 1 Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring circuit, edging Kimi Antonelli by one-hundredth of a second. Max Verstappen qualified third, with Hamilton and Leclerc rounding out the top five.

stories.title: Iran-US war latest: Trump claims Houthis asked US not to intervene in Yemen as drone hits Saudi Arabia oil pipeline

en.title: Iran-US war latest: Trump claims Houthis asked US not to intervene in Yemen as drone hits Saudi Arabia oil pipeline
en.summary: A drone has struck a Saudi Arabian oil pipeline amid ongoing regional tensions. The Houthis have captured a strategic island in the Bab el-Mandeb strait, raising concerns about economic disruption.

stories.title: Trump says united Ireland would be 'fantastic' during visit to Dublin

en.title: Trump says united Ireland would be 'fantastic' during visit to Dublin
en.summary: During a meeting with Irish leader Micheál Martin, Trump expressed support for a united Ireland. The UK government stated it will adhere to the Good Friday Agreement.

stories.title: Donald Trump says he would ‘love’ to see united Ireland

en.title: Donald Trump says he would 'love' to see united Ireland
en.summary: Trump stated during an Ireland visit that he supports Irish unification and believes it should happen now. His comments drew criticism from the UK government and Northern Ireland's unionist leaders.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq

en.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
en.summary: A drone attack from Iraq damaged a key Saudi Arabian oil pipeline. Iraq removed a military commander and launched investigations into the attack originating from an area near the Iranian border.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia shuts East-West pipeline that bypasses Hormuz after attacks

en.title: Saudi Arabia shuts East-West pipeline that bypasses Hormuz after attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has closed an East-West pipeline that provided an alternative route around the Strait of Hormuz following attacks on infrastructure. The closure is expected to contribute to increases in global oil prices.

es.title: Arabia Saudí cierra oleoducto Este-Oeste que elude el Estrecho de Ormuz tras ataques
es.summary: Arabia Saudí ha cerrado un oleoducto Este-Oeste que ofrecía una ruta alternativa alrededor del Estrecho de Ormuz después de ataques. El cierre se espera que contribuya a aumentos en los precios mundiales del petróleo.

fr.title: L'Arabie Saoudite ferme l'oléoduc Est-Ouest contournant le Détroit d'Ormuz après des attaques
fr.summary: L'Arabie Saoudite a fermé un oléoduc Est-Ouest offrant un itinéraire alternatif contournant le Détroit d'Ormuz suite à des attaques. La fermeture devrait contribuer à des augmentations des prix mondiaux du pétrole.

pt.title: Arábia Saudita fecha oleoduto Leste-Oeste que desvia do Estreito de Ormuz após ataques
pt.summary: A Arábia Saudita fechou um oleoduto Leste-Oeste que oferecia uma rota alternativa contornando o Estreito de Ormuz após ataques. O fechamento deverá contribuir para aumentos nos preços globais do petróleo.

de.title: Saudi-Arabien schließt Ost-West-Pipeline, die die Straße von Hormuz umgeht, nach Angriffen
de.summary: Saudi-Arabien hat eine Ost-West-Pipeline geschlossen, die eine alternative Route um die Straße von Hormuz bot, nach Angriffen. Die Schließung dürfte zu Erhöhungen der Ölpreise weltweit beitragen.

it.title: L'Arabia Saudita chiude il gasdotto Est-Ovest che aggira lo Stretto di Hormuz dopo gli attacchi
it.summary: L'Arabia Saudita ha chiuso un gasdotto Est-Ovest che offriva un percorso alternativo intorno allo Stretto di Hormuz a seguito di attacchi. La chiusura dovrebbe contribuire a aumenti dei prezzi del petrolio a livello mondiale.

ru.title: Саудовская Аравия закрывает трубопровод Восток-Запад, обходящий Ормузский пролив, после атак
ru.summary: Саудовская Аравия закрыла трубопровод Восток-Запад, предоставляющий альтернативный маршрут вокруг Ормузского пролива, после атак. Закрытие, вероятно, будет способствовать повышению мировых цен на нефть.

ar.title: السعودية تغلق خط أنابيب الشرق-الغرب الذي يتجاوز مضيق هرمز بعد الهجمات
ar.summary: أغلقت السعودية خط أنابيب الشرق-الغرب الذي يوفر طريقاً بديلة حول مضيق هرمز بعد هجمات. من المتوقع أن يساهم الإغلاق في ارتفاع أسعار النفط العالمية.

hi.title: सऊदी अरब ने हमलों के बाद होर्मुज़ को दरकिनार करने वाली पूर्व-पश्चिम पाइपलाइन को बंद किया
hi.summary: सऊदी अरब ने होर्मुज़ जलडमरूमध्य के चारों ओर एक वैकल्पिक मार्ग प्रदान करने वाली पूर्व-पश्चिम पाइपलाइन को हमलों के बाद बंद कर दिया। बंद होने से वैश्विक तेल कीमतों में वृद्धि की संभावना है।

zh.title: 沙特阿拉伯在遭受攻击后关闭绕过荷尔木兹海峡的东西管道
zh.summary: 沙特阿拉伯在遭受攻击后关闭了提供绕过荷尔木兹海峡替代路线的东西管道。此举可能会推高全球油价。

ja.title: サウジアラビア、攻撃後にホルムズ海峡を迂回する東西パイプラインを閉鎖
ja.summary: サウジアラビアは攻撃を受けた後、ホルムズ海峡を迂回する代替ルートを提供していた東西パイプラインを閉鎖した。この措置は世界的な石油価格の上昇につながると予想される。

ko.title: 사우디아라비아, 공격 후 호르무즈 해협을 우회하는 동서 파이프라인 폐쇄
ko.summary: 사우디아라비아는 공격 후 호르무즈 해협을 우회하는 대체 경로를 제공하던 동서 파이프라인을 폐쇄했다. 이 조치는 글로벌 유가 상승을 초래할 것으로 예상된다.

stories.title: Brics push for Gulf peace as war worries mount

en.title: Brics push for Gulf peace as war worries mount
en.summary: Brics nations are working toward peace in the Gulf region amid escalating conflicts. Efforts face complications from economic and geopolitical tensions between India and China.

stories.title: Trump says united Ireland ‘inevitable’ and ‘a very cool thing’

en.title: Trump says united Ireland 'inevitable' and 'a very cool thing'
en.summary: Trump made informal remarks during an Ireland visit characterizing Irish unification as inevitable and positive. His comments angered pro-UK political parties.

en.title: We are setting up a generation to fail at school
en.summary: Global test scores are declining, with curriculum changes identified as a contributing factor to students' academic performance.
